newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling gains on dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling gains on dollar, pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling gained against the dollar and pound sterling, the Bank of Tanzania (BoT) said on Thursday.
The shilling exchanged at a commercial mean rate of 624.6900 to a dollar from Wednesday's rate 624.6999. Against the pound, it was posted at 1020.0266 from 1023.5739.
The shilling has depreciated from a level of 608.0580 to the dollar, a month ago, mostly due to anticipation by the local business community of tax reductions in the June 19 budget statement.
